content: In Nafsat I, per Melvin-Koushki, Ibn Turka cites living masters who write to the same end: Khwāja Muḥammad Pārsā, who composed treatises on such topics and taught the qasida of Ibn al-Fāriḍ to his son, with a treatise showing his esteem for Ibn al-Fāriḍ; Sayyid Sharīf Jurjānī's famous Sufi treatise (the Taʿrīfāt); and Shams al-Dīn Fanārī.
